output.headline: Ironvale regain composure after direct ball breaks down
output.text: Leading 1-0, Ironvale's direct ball from Callum Reid went 41.8 forward, but Luca Romero's pass was intercepted. Zeke Mbeki then played it back -13.4 to Hiro Tanaka, who carried calmly, steadying momentum at 25 with chaos at 54.
